scope: Recovered Library documents and media, current Codex embedded plates, Drive master and visual index, linked Drive videos, and the complete First Rain v17 gameplay source and asset inventory. Not a claim of exhaustive conversation recovery.
limitations: Conversation retrieval failed during the initial recovery; a later targeted query recovered species 005/006 approval decisions. Broad historical conversation coverage remains incomplete.
The current Codex is v1.6. Earlier Codex texts are retained as historical sources, not merged blindly.
Source image text is unverified unless separately accepted. Lilavyn poster numbering and Helivyn atlas naming conflict with v1.5.
Drive canonical-images and working-reference folders were empty when inspected. Two videos are linked, not converted to 3D assets.
Existing PHYVERA database remains preserved; this archive is a versioned read-only source collection.
Terrain dimensions, local landforms, exact planetary arrangement and species ranges are not finalized canon.

Additional Library opening-video variants were recovered and indexed but are not embedded for playback. First Rain sprites are historical; the game’s early lineage names and water-triggered awakening are not adopted into current canon.

Codex v1.6 establishes Irivyn 005 and Lilloryn 006 as locked concepts; detailed mechanisms and poster claims remain provisional. Nymphara and Mycelith are rejected. Every field-guide entry now includes sex differences and distinguishes ancestral plant biology from proposed post-Kindling specialization.

CONTENTS
THE SEEDWOKEN CODEX is the living reference work of Vaelora: part natural history, world atlas, dictionary, encyclopedia, and visual canon. Entries distinguish established canon from unresolved questions and are designed to expand without losing continuity.

VAELORA
THE LIVING WORLD
Vaelora is an ocean-bearing living world of six major continents, vast seas, mountain crowns, volcanic provinces, fragmented archipelagos, rain-shadow interiors, polar wilderness, and ecosystems that have spread into nearly every environment capable of sustaining them.
From orbit, the world is familiar enough to understand and strange enough to know it is not Earth. Deep blue and blue-green oceans surround continents shaped by their own tectonic history. Warm shallow seas shift through turquoise, jade, and restrained violet-blue. Great river systems divide green interiors; island arcs trace active crust; glaciers occupy high ranges and polar ground; immense weather systems carry water and heat across the globe.
Six Environmental Giants
Vaelora's six continents are not single-biome territories. Each contains many climates shaped by latitude, elevation, mountains, currents, and distance from the sea. Their present working identities describe their largest environmental signatures rather than permanent names.
The six are now known as Elaris, the Mainland; Sahrel, the Sunscar; Caelune, the Crown; Vulkara, the Broken Furnace; Thyrra, the Thousand Shores; and Nythrune, the Veiled Wilds. Their strongest identities range from great river country and deserts to high mountains, active volcanism, fragmented seas, and ancient hypercompetitive wilderness. None is a single-biome territory.
A Planet That Participates
Vaelora is more than the place where life happens. Its ground, water, deep interior, and living systems carry the unexplained phenomenon called Vael. Whether this reflects consciousness, a planetary biological network, something divine, or something for which no useful category yet exists remains unresolved.
Most of the time, geology remains geology, rain remains weather, and roots still survive by water, minerals, light, and chemistry. Vael is not an excuse for every mystery. Its clearest intervention is rarer and far more consequential: when Vael enters the roots of a selected seedling and the Kindling begins.
Life grows upon Vaelora. Life awakens because of it.

THE SIX CONTINENTS OF VAELORA
Vaelora's continents are environmental giants rather than single-biome territories. Latitude, elevation, currents, geology, rain shadows, and distance from the sea create many ecosystems within each landmass. Elaris is called the Mainland for cultural and historical reasons, not because it must be the physically largest continent.
ELARIS — THE MAINLAND
The temperate and civilizational heartland of the currently known world. Elaris combines broad forests, grasslands, wetlands, freshwater lakes, river valleys, foothills, colder northern forests, and warmer southern regions. Its relative environmental balance has supported extensive movement, settlement, study, and exchange, though its wilderness is by no means harmless.
The Vaelorin is Vaelora's greatest known river, descending from the mountainous interior and crossing much of Elaris before opening into an immense wetland delta. Settlements, migration routes, pollinator corridors, and major ecosystems gather around it. The Silren, Mossrun, Avenwater, the Briarwash, and Orin's Fork are important tributaries and regional rivers without rivaling the Vaelorin's planetary significance.

ELARIS — GEOGRAPHIC REFERENCE 001

Canonical physical-geography reference • The Mainland • Vaelora
This image establishes Elaris’s recognizable continental silhouette, Vaelorin river corridor and southern delta, northern source highlands and lake country, broad temperate interior, warmer southern wetlands and shallows, western island chains, southwestern bay, southeastern coast, and southern archipelagos. Future maps, regional names, ecology, settlements, histories, and stories should explain and correlate with these visible features rather than replacing them arbitrarily.

SAHREL — THE SUNSCAR
A dry continent whose geology remembers a wetter age. Ancient river valleys, fossil lake beds, salt flats, canyon systems, underground aquifers, oasis ecosystems, dry grasslands, and elevated desert plateaus reveal landscapes repeatedly transformed by water and its absence.
The Sunscar is Sahrel's immense arid basin, enclosed by high plateaus and marked by severe day-night temperature swings. Rare rains can awaken dormant seed banks across enormous areas, briefly turning apparently barren country into explosive fields of growth and flowering.

SAHREL — GEOGRAPHIC REFERENCE 001

Canonical physical-geography plate. The visible Sunscar basin, northern remnant lake and watershed, ancient drainage networks, canyon and plateau country, southern dune system, surviving southern water corridor, coastal transitions, and island systems are now continuity constraints for future Sahrel geography and lore.
Codex rule: major visible features in accepted geographic references are intended to be named, explained, and connected to geology, climate, ecology, history, cultures, species, travel, or story as the Seedwoken reference work develops.

CAELUNE — THE CROWN
Vaelora's great high-altitude continent. Mountain forests rise into cloud forests, plateaus, alpine meadows, exposed rock, glaciers, glacial lakes, and cold desert. Isolated valleys support lineages separated by formidable terrain.
The Crownspine is a colossal system of converging mountain ranges. At its greatest convergence rises Mount Aevor, Vaelora's highest known mountain: a distinctive split crown of gigantic summit horns surrounding an ancient central glacial basin. Caelune's greatest killers are often ordinary physics—altitude, exposure, avalanche, crevasse, and violent weather.

CAELUNE — GEOGRAPHIC REFERENCE 001

Canonical continental-scale physical-geography plate. It establishes Caelune's macro-geography: the Crownspine's approximate extent and orientation, the great elevated interior, wet western forest-and-fjord country, eastern high rain-shadow steppe, northern glaciated terrain, interior lake and meltwater systems, the principal south-flowing watershed, southern lowlands, and major island systems.
Scale note: Mount Aevor's approximate position is established within the upper-central Crownspine convergence, but this distant continental rendering does not define its final local morphology. A dedicated Mount Aevor geographic reference will later establish the split-crown summit, ancient high glacial basin, glaciers, and surrounding terrain at appropriate scale.

VULKARA — THE BROKEN FURNACE
One of Vaelora's two extreme-danger continents. Vulkara occupies a violently active tectonic province of volcanoes, earthquakes, ashfall, geothermal fields, fumaroles, hot springs, acidic and mineral-rich soils, unstable ground, and young volcanic islands. Destruction and recolonization are routine ecological pressures.
The Cinderwake is the great active volcanic belt crossing Vulkara and continuing offshore through island arcs. It corresponds broadly to the prominent volcanic region visible on the canonical orbital cover. Vulkara is dangerous because the ground itself is unstable.
THYRRA — THE THOUSAND SHORES
An ancient continental mass fragmented by rifting and rising seas until the distinction between continent and archipelago became argumentative. Large islands, peninsulas, reefs, shallow and inland seas, drowned valleys, tidal wetlands, coastal cliffs, tropical forests, mangrove analogues, marine meadows, and inland highlands create extraordinary ecological isolation and exchange.
Its vast fragmented coastal realm is called the Thousand Shores; the number is poetic, not a survey result. Thyrra is a natural future center for studying aquatic and amphibious Phyvera and corresponds broadly to the turquoise archipelagos and shallow seas visible on the canonical cover.
NYTHRUNE — THE VEILED WILDS
Vaelora's second extreme-danger continent, and the opposite of Vulkara. Its ancient stable landscapes allowed biological competition to intensify over immense spans of time. Multilayer forests, parasitic plants, complex fungal networks, wetlands, enormous root systems, defensive vegetation, and coevolved predators make life itself the principal hazard.
The Veil is a vast forest-wetland complex whose canopies stack into multiple ecological worlds, leaving portions of the ground almost untouched by direct sunlight. Somewhere deeper lies the Firstroot. Reports disagree whether it is an organism, a geological structure consumed by roots, a site of unusual Vael activity, a myth, or something for which the Codex has no category. For now, it remains unresolved.
Polar Vaelora
Vaelora has substantial permanent ice, polar land, islands, glaciers, and sea ice, but no continent exists merely to serve as an Antarctica analogue. Polar environments instead occupy the extreme reaches of existing continental systems, including portions associated with Caelune and Thyrra. This preserves the frozen terrain visible from orbit while allowing the six continents to remain ecologically distinct.
Two Ways to Die
In Vulkara, the ground tries to kill you. In Nythrune, everything growing on it might beat the ground to it.

AWAKENING
Vaelora's planetary mystery becomes biologically consequential through Vael, the Kindling, and the developmental pathway that produces Phyvera. This section separates physical geography from the mechanisms of awakening.
The Kindling
A Kindling is the single, irreversible event in which Vael enters a selected rooted seedling or sapling and diverts it into Phyveran development. It happens once. It does not sputter, reconsider, or ask for a second attempt.
To a witness, the event begins below or within the roots as a bioluminescent pulse. Light branches through the root network, converges at the root crown, then races upward through vascular tissue, stem, leaves, and finally the growing tip. When the light fades, the plant may look nearly ordinary. It is not.
If a Kindling begins, awakening has succeeded; the organism can still later die from injury, disease, drought, or other ordinary causes. Why Vaelora Kindles one seedling and leaves another rooted in an ordinary botanical life is one of the central unanswered questions of the world.
Seedform
After Kindling, the plant redirects development toward a rooted enclosed structure called a Seedform—colloquially, an egg. It is not laid. It is grown. Shoots fold inward, protective tissues thicken, and the established root network continues supplying water and minerals while a mobile Phyveran body develops within.
A Seedform should resemble the developmental logic of its plant lineage rather than an animal egg with leaves glued to it. In Rosavyn, that means something closer to a rose bud, gall, seed pod, and tightly folded cane growth. At emergence, parts of the original root system become incorporated into the young Phyveran's rootlike feet.
Rosavyn Seedform Morphology
The canonical Rosavyn Seedform is compact, rooted, and roughly ovoid, but it is not an animal egg. Living rose canes and protective botanical layers curve upward and inward around the developing organism, producing a form reminiscent of a tightly closed rose bud, gall, seed pod, and folded cane growth. The roots visibly transition into the base and remain the Seedform's active connection to soil, water, and minerals.
The Seedform is not a container surrounding a separate creature. The entire structure is part of the developing Rosavyn. Future refinements should favor more tightly closed protective layers, folded young cane tissue and bud-scale-like growth, while keeping defensive structures anatomically faithful to rose prickles rather than oversized fantasy thorns.
Veyra Emergence
The Kindling initiates Veyra expression. During the transforming Kindled-seedling phase, subtle pigmentation hints may appear in new growth. By the mature Seedform stage, the future Rosavyn's Veyra is reliably visible to parents and other observers.
The Seedform doesn't conceal the Veyra. It announces it.
Veyra changes tissue pigmentation, not Seedform anatomy. Rosavyn Seedforms therefore share the same fundamental construction across Pale Thorn, Sage, Golden Cane, Roseblush, Mauve, Copper, Mahogany, and Umber. Pigmentation must remain biologically integrated into living tissues, with plausible gradients and secondary colors rather than paint, shell coating, flat uniform color, or persistent magical glow.
The currently accepted Roseblush reference establishes the foundational Seedform morphology. Its generated measurements and incidental card text are not canonical unless separately approved, and the design may be refined later without discarding its core biological construction.

Rosavyn — Canonical Seedform Reference 001: Roseblush Veyra

The First Law of Awakening
Love and mating create seeds. Seeds create plants. Only Vaelora creates Seedwoken.


PHYVERA SPECIES  •  ENTRY 001
001 — ROSAVYN
Rose-line Phyvera  •  Botanical ancestry: Rosa spp.
A rose learned to walk. Predictably, it kept the prickles.
Field Profile
What Makes a Rosavyn a Rosavyn?
Rosavyn are not people wearing botanical accessories. Their bodies are the rose. Intertwined living canes form the frame; older load-bearing tissues lignify into textured wood while younger growth stays smoother, greener, and often red with anthocyanin. Pinnately compound, serrated leaves emerge from believable growth nodes. Curved prickles arise from cane tissue. Flowers are costly reproductive structures, not permanent jewelry.
Sex & Bloom
Rosavyn share one body plan, but mature floral placement creates a clear secondary sexual signal. Females develop the dominant bloom at the crown, where it reads almost like living floral hair without ceasing to be a real flower. Males carry the dominant bloom on a shoulder, shoulder blade, or upper back, visually broadening the silhouette like a botanical echo of musculature. Placement can be asymmetric; nature has never been famous for using a ruler.
The Prickle Trick
Rosavyn can voluntarily extend and retract their prickles into specialized cane tissue. Young individuals possess the structures but do not yet have full control. Mastery arrives around a future-defined maturation threshold analogous to puberty or coming of age; the exact age remains deliberately unsettled. Retraction makes close social contact and movement through dense growth safer. Extension restores the rose's ancient argument: please do not grab me.
Veyra
Veyra is the Phyveran term for an individual's dominant inherited body-tissue pigmentation expression. It is analogous to a pigmentation phenotype, not a race, sex, subspecies, ecotype, or flower color. A Veyra can shift in appearance across young shoots, old wood, scars, joints, seasons, and other tissues without becoming a different Veyra.
Floral Expression
Flower color is inherited separately from Veyra. Ordinary Rosavyn may bloom white or ivory, blush and pink, coral, salmon or apricot, yellow and golden, orange, scarlet, crimson, burgundy, lavender or mauve, near-black red, and natural gradients or bicolors. True blue is not an ordinary rose trait; a genuinely blue Rosavyn bloom would be a meaningful Phyveran mutation or event, not a paint swatch.
Seasonal Life
Spring — Awakening: Dormant buds break, reddish young shoots appear, and activity rises.
Early Summer — Bloom: Foliage, fragrance, flowers, and pollinator activity reach their peak.
Late Summer / Autumn — Fruiting: Successful flowers may develop rose hips; growth slows while resources are stored.
Winter — Dormancy: Foliage can diminish or fall depending on lineage and climate. Woody structure dominates and movement slows.
Ecology & Behavior
Rosavyn are defensive and territorial more often than aggressive. When threatened they can contract their prickle-bearing limbs, hook or entangle with flexible canes, and protect rather than chase. Bees and other pollinators are ecological partners, not decorative particle effects. Fragrance, flower posture, pigmentation, and condition can also signal health, stress, and reproductive state.
Resource allocation tells a story. Favorable light, water, nutrients, and low threat pressure favor leaves, flowers, fragrance, and fruit. Sustained stress favors denser cane, lignification, defense, and reduced flowering. Two genetically similar Rosavyn can therefore grow into visibly different adults without anyone needing to invent a 'battle skin.'
Genetics & Variation
Inherited ranges may affect flower color, petal number, fragrance chemistry, growth habit, mature size, foliage pigmentation, prickle density, hip size, disease resistance, and cold or drought tolerance. Environment modifies expression within plausible limits. Ecotypes and subspecies require real ecological or biological differences; color alone does not qualify.
Reproduction: Seeds Before Miracles
Rosavyn reproduction remains botanical at its core. Flowers, pollen, fertilization, rose hips, and seeds matter. Pair bonds and love can exist independently of reproduction, and pollinators may participate in both biology and culture. Successful reproduction can produce rose hips carrying genetically inherited seeds.
Those seeds are not guaranteed children in the walking sense. They germinate as plants. Some may live their entire lives as rooted roses; a seedling becomes Rosavyn only if Vaelora Kindles it. A family lineage may therefore include both mobile Rosavyn and rooted rose descendants, making ancestral gardens quite literally family gardens.
Exact male/female reproductive roles are intentionally unresolved. Real roses often contain both male and female floral structures, so Rosavyn reproduction will be designed from botanical biology rather than forcing mammalian mechanics onto a rose.
Biological Realism & Sex Differences
Earth roses usually bear bisexual flowers, so Rosavyn male/female identity is treated as a Vaeloran post-Kindling specialization rather than a direct copy of Rosa reproduction. The established crown-bloom female and shoulder/back-bloom male pattern remains a secondary sexual signal. Future reproductive canon should preserve real rose structures—stamens, carpels, pollination, hips, and seeds—while allowing the two sexes to bias reproductive investment differently. Retractable prickles remain an explicit fantasy adaptation: real rose prickles are fixed epidermal/cortical outgrowths, so Rosavyn control requires specialized living attachment tissue and carries a tissue/energy cost.
Signature Talent — Briarhold
Under severe threat, a Rosavyn can redirect stored resources into rapid extension and interlocking of existing young canes, forming a temporary living briar enclosure. It costs water and stored carbohydrates. Repeated use can suppress flowering, exhaust the individual, or cause cane dieback. Heroics, regrettably, still require calories.
Vulnerabilities
Fire becomes especially dangerous as woody tissue accumulates. Drought limits regeneration and bloom. Persistent fungal disease can strip vigor from the whole organism, heavy shade reduces growth, and overinvestment in defense steals resources from reproduction and fruiting.
Developmental Stages
Rosavyn development begins as ordinary Rosa-line life: Seed → Germination/Seedling. Most unkindled seedlings continue as ordinary rooted plants. A selected seedling experiences the Kindling, then passes through Transforming Kindled Seedling → Seedform → Infant → Mid Stage → Adult. The accepted Seedform, Infant, Mid Stage, and Adult references now anchor the developmental direction; ordinary germination, the Kindling event, and the transforming seedling remain to be visually established.
Official Visual Record
Rosavyn visual canon now includes Official Image Card 001 for the adult male and female, plus accepted Mid Stage female, Mid Stage male, Infant male, and Infant female reference cards. Together they establish a continuous developmental direction from infancy through adulthood. Female dominant blooms develop at the crown/head; male dominant blooms develop at the shoulder, shoulder blade, or upper back. Seedling remains the only major Rosavyn developmental stage not yet visually established. Earlier exploratory Rosavyn generations remain non-canon.

Rosavyn — Official Image Card 001

Canonical Developmental Gallery
Accepted visual canon currently covers Adult, Mid Stage, and Infant Rosavyn. Seedling remains intentionally open for the next developmental design.

Rosavyn — Official Mid Stage: Female

Rosavyn — Official Mid Stage: Male

Rosavyn — Official Infant Stage: Male

Rosavyn — Official Infant Stage: Female


Solavyr
SPECIES 002 • SUNFLOWER-LINE PHYVERA
Classification: Phyvera
Botanical ancestry: Helianthus spp.; sunflower-line.
Core identity: Height, sunlight, endurance, pollination, reproductive investment, resilience, and ecological coexistence.
Adult scale: Males approximately 6–8 ft; females approximately 5.5–7.5 ft, with substantial individual overlap.
Biology & Ecology
Solavyr are mobile sunflower-derived Phyvera built from reinforced herbaceous stalk anatomy rather than woody tree tissue. Their bodies retain longitudinal vascular structure, coarse botanical trichomes, growth nodes, large functional Helianthus leaves, and compact root-derived feet. They are not primarily attack organisms: defense favors tough fibrous tissues, deterrent chemistry, trichomes, stability, and endurance. Their ecology is strongly pollinator-associated, and long-established Solavyr populations may influence nearby plant communities through the chemistry of shed tissues and root-associated compounds.
Light Orientation & Rest
Young Solavyr retain strong heliotropic and circadian repositioning. Adults retain exceptional awareness of sunlight direction, day length, sunrise, and seasonal change without continuously tracking the sun. Night rest is typically a stabilized standing or partially crouched brace-rest: root-feet spread for support, foliage lowers, activity decreases, and reproductive structures remain protected.
Sexual Dimorphism
Sex is primarily distinguished by reproductive architecture rather than human-like coloration. Adult males carry a predominantly forward-facing, upright capitulum associated with pollen presentation and pollinator exposure. Adult females carry a backward-facing, slightly upward/oblique capitulum on a separate reinforced peduncle emerging from the upper back. The female peduncle is physically separate from the neck and built to support increasing seed mass. As seeds mature, the capitulum may progress from backward/upward to backward and finally backward/downward. Canonical female anatomy also includes a fuller paired botanical chest structure, a substantial load-bearing build, and somewhat narrower, more elegant functional leaves.
Biological Realism Note
The Solavyr sex system is derived Seedwoken biology, not ordinary sunflower reproduction. Earth Helianthus heads contain many florets and commonly include fertile bisexual disc florets. In Solavyr, the Kindling is proposed to canalize that ancestral reproductive machinery into sex-biased capitula: males invest more heavily in pollen presentation, while females invest more heavily in ovule, seed, and load-bearing capitulum development. This preserves recognizable sunflower floral anatomy while making adult sex differences biologically functional.
Signature Defensive Talent — Sunbrace
Under severe physical stress, a Solavyr can redistribute tension through reinforced fibrous tissues, spread its root-derived feet, lower its center of gravity, and stiffen major vascular/fiber bundles. Sunbrace improves resistance to wind and impact but can cause tissue strain, temporary rigidity, and vascular damage if overused.


Canonical Visual Record — Adult Male

Solavyr Adult Male — Anatomical Reference 001. Canonical adult male visual anchor; forward-facing capitulum in all rotational views.


Canonical Visual Record — Adult Female

Solavyr Adult Female — Anatomical Reference 001. Canonical adult female visual anchor.
Tomavyn
SPECIES 003 • TOMATO-LINE PHYVERA
Classification: Phyvera
Botanical ancestry: Solanum lycopersicum; tomato-line.
Status: Established species; active biological and visual development.
Core identity: Herbaceous living plant anatomy, chlorophyll-rich structural tissue, mature red carotenoid-rich storage corridors, glandular trichomes, true tomato-leaf morphology, and biologically integrated fruit-line traits.
Biology & Visual Direction
Tomavyn are tomato-derived Phyvera whose bodies remain living herbaceous plant tissue rather than bark-armored humanoids. Green photosynthetic and structural tissues dominate the body, while mature red tissues are integrated through vascular and storage regions rather than appearing as attached tomatoes, exposed muscle, paint, or decoration. Fine glandular trichomes and recognizable tomato foliage remain important ancestry markers.
Adult Sexual Dimorphism
Tomavyn visual dimorphism can include broader shoulders, a wider upper torso, and greater green-tissue dominance in the established adult male, but these are secondary traits rather than the biological definition of sex. Earth tomato flowers are normally bisexual/perfect, so Tomavyn male and female forms represent a Vaeloran post-Kindling reproductive specialization. Proposed male reproductive clusters emphasize viable pollen production with reduced ovary investment; proposed female clusters emphasize stigma/ovary function and seed-bearing reproductive structures after fertilization, with reduced pollen investment. Both sexes retain recognizable tomato floral ancestry and glandular trichomes. The species remains herbaceous: no bark armor, no exposed-muscle look, and no decorative tomatoes embedded in the body.
Canonical / Accepted Visual Record
Tomavyn adult visual development is established in the Seedwoken archive, including the accepted adult male direction and its front, side, back, portrait, tissue, leaf, and surface-detail studies. Further lifecycle, reproductive, ecological, Veyra, and regional canon should remain open until explicitly accepted.

Lilavyn
SPECIES 004 • LILAC-LINE PHYVERA • CONCEPT
Classification: Phyvera
Botanical ancestry: Syringa vulgaris; common-lilac line.
Status: LOCKED CONCEPT — accepted as the fourth Seedwoken species direction; detailed biology remains provisional until developed.
Concept identity: Fragrance, clustered spring bloom architecture, flexible multi-stem growth, pollinator relationships, seasonal expression, and regenerative/suckering potential.
Concept Foundation
Lilavyn are the fourth Seedwoken species concept, following Rosavyn, Solavyr, and Tomavyn. Their design direction is lilac-derived and should remain grounded in real Syringa biology: opposite simple leaves, terminal flower panicles, fragrant tubular flowers, multi-stem shrub growth, and the lineage's ability to produce basal or root suckers.
Proposed Biological Direction
The accepted concept explores fragrance as meaningful biological signaling, dense reproductive flower clusters rather than decorative blossoms, pollinator-linked ecology, seasonal changes in flowering and resource allocation, and unusually strong vegetative recovery. These are concept-level directions, not finalized mechanisms. Future development must determine anatomy, reproduction, sexual dimorphism, defensive adaptations, lifecycle morphology, Veyra, ecology, and geographic placement before those details become canon.
Sex Differences & Biological Realism
Common lilac is a woody, multi-stemmed shrub with opposite simple leaves and terminal panicles of fragrant tubular flowers. Its flowers are ordinarily bisexual, so Lilavyn sexes are a derived Seedwoken specialization rather than a literal Syringa trait. Proposed males develop pollen-biased panicles with proportionally stronger anther output and somewhat lighter reproductive loading; proposed females develop ovule/fruit-biased panicles and invest more strongly in fertilized capsules and seed maturation. Fragrance remains important in both sexes and can vary with reproductive state. Vegetative recovery should use realistic basal/root suckering and woody regrowth rather than instant regeneration.
Visual Concept Record
Lilavyn Concept Reference 001 — accepted September 9, 2026. The first concept establishes the lilac-derived visual direction and adult male/female exploration. The image itself incorrectly labels the species as “Species 002”; that numbering is superseded. Lilavyn is Species 004. The concept is accepted, while individual anatomy, color variants, lifecycle depictions, region, and written biological claims shown on the exploratory poster remain provisional unless separately confirmed.

Irivyn
SPECIES 005 • IRIS-LINE PHYVERA • LOCKED CONCEPT
Classification: Phyvera
Botanical ancestry: Iris spp.; iris-line, with exact ancestral clade still open.
Status: LOCKED CONCEPT — foundational visual direction accepted; detailed region, Veyra, abilities, and lifecycle morphology remain provisional.
Concept identity: Rhizome/bulb-line persistence, sword-like foliage, highly structured iris flowers, seasonal renewal, and strong environmental sensitivity.
Biology Foundation
Irivyn should preserve the defining architecture of Iris: herbaceous perennial tissues; long, strap-like or sword-shaped leaves; flowers organized around three outer falls and three inner standards; and underground storage/renewal organs that may be rhizomes, corms, or bulbs depending on the eventual ancestral lineage. The concept may favor a rhizomatous wet-meadow or waterside lineage, but “iris” does not automatically mean aquatic: many Iris species occupy ordinary meadows, slopes, or comparatively dry habitats. Any final habitat must match the chosen ancestry.
Sex Differences
Most Earth irises have flowers containing both pollen-producing and ovule-producing organs. Irivyn male/female forms therefore represent a post-Kindling specialization. Proposed males bias floral investment toward prominent anthers, pollen production, and display structures; proposed females bias investment toward receptive stigmatic tissue, ovary development, capsule formation, and seed provisioning. External differences may be subtle: flower orientation, reproductive-organ proportions, body resource storage, and seasonal condition should identify sex more reliably than human-like body shape alone.
Biological Limits
Rhizome-based regeneration can support clonal recovery and replacement shoots, but it is not instant healing. Severe rhizome damage, rot, drought, nutrient shortage, or loss of photosynthetic foliage should remain meaningful threats. Bioluminescence, supernatural water sensing, and other poster ideas are not yet canon and require separate biological justification before acceptance.
Visual Concept Record
Irivyn Concept Reference 001 — accepted September 9, 2026 as Species 005 concept direction. The adult silhouettes and iris-derived floral language are retained as the visual foundation. Poster-specific Veyra names, region assignment, ecological role, bioluminescence, and exact abilities remain proposals.

Lilloryn
SPECIES 006 • TRUE-LILY-LINE PHYVERA • LOCKED CONCEPT
Classification: Phyvera
Botanical ancestry: Lilium spp.; true-lily line.
Status: LOCKED CONCEPT — replaces the rejected Nymphara and Mycelith Species 006 directions.
Concept identity: Bulb-stored resilience, upright herbaceous growth, six-tepal floral architecture, fragrance/pollinator signaling, seasonal dormancy, and elegant but structurally functional foliage.
Biology Foundation
Lilloryn are true-lily-derived Phyvera and should be built from herbaceous perennial anatomy rather than aquatic water-lily anatomy. Their ancestry is anchored by underground bulbs, erect stems, simple leaves with parallel venation, and large flowers composed of six tepals with six stamens surrounding a central style/ovary system. Many Lilium flowers are fragrant and pollinator-associated. Their bodies may favor moist valleys, lake margins, or sheltered fertile ground, but the species is not inherently aquatic or semi-aquatic. Persistent waterlogging is a biological liability because true-lily bulbs are vulnerable to rot in poorly drained soil.
Sex Differences
Earth Lilium flowers normally combine stamens and pistil in the same flower, so Lilloryn sex differences are a Vaeloran specialization created after the Kindling. Proposed males allocate more reproductive tissue to elongated stamens, versatile anthers, pollen quantity, and fragrance/display used to attract pollinators. Proposed females allocate more tissue to stigma receptivity, the central style/ovary system, three-part capsule development, seed provisioning, and bulb reserves needed to recover after reproduction. Females may therefore carry slightly heavier lower-torso/bulb-derived storage anatomy, while males may show more conspicuous pollen-bearing floral structures. Both remain unmistakably the same species, and some individuals can be visually difficult to sex outside flowering season.
Growth, Defense & Limits
The bulb is a major reserve organ and can support seasonal dieback followed by regrowth, giving Lilloryn strong recovery across seasons without making them rapidly regenerative. Damage that destroys the basal plate, major bulb scales, or enough stored carbohydrate can be fatal. Floral tepals are display and reproductive structures, not armor; defensive adaptations should instead arise from toughened vegetative tissue, chemistry, posture, or other separately developed mechanisms. Any future toxicity must be defined carefully from a chosen Lilium lineage rather than generalized from the plant’s well-known danger to particular Earth animals.
Visual Concept Record
Lilloryn Concept Reference 001 — accepted September 9, 2026 as Species 006. The latest lily-derived adult male/female concept is the foundational visual direction. Its wetland scenery is aesthetic/environmental exploration, not evidence that Lilloryn are aquatic. Poster Veyra names, healing roles, water-filtration claims, and rapid tissue-regeneration claims are not canon unless later developed and approved.

CODEX GROWTH NOTES
This Codex is intentionally modular. New species can be inserted as self-contained entries; accepted images can be added to each species' Visual Record; biology can be revised without rebuilding the book. The blank opening page is reserved for the future Seedwoken Codex cover artwork. Current species sequence: 001 Rosavyn (rose-line), 002 Solavyr (sunflower-line), 003 Tomavyn (tomato-line), 004 Lilavyn (lilac-line concept), 005 Irivyn (iris-line concept), and 006 Lilloryn (true-lily-line concept). Future species entries must include a Sexual Dimorphism / Sex Differences section, even when differences are subtle or seasonally visible.
BIOLOGICAL REALISM STANDARD
Seedwoken uses Naturalistic Biological Fantasy: approximately 70% recognizable biology and 30% fantasy adaptation. Each Phyvera should preserve meaningful traits of its Earth-plant ancestry—growth form, tissues, leaves, roots or storage organs, vascular logic, flowers, pollination, fruit/seed structures, chemistry, seasonality, ecological relationships, and real limitations. Fantasy traits should normally be extensions of those systems with costs and constraints. When an ancestral Earth plant has bisexual flowers but the Phyvera has male and female individuals, the Codex must explicitly identify that split as a post-Kindling Vaeloran specialization rather than falsely claiming the Earth plant is naturally dioecious. Visual sexual dimorphism should follow reproductive investment and plant architecture first; human-like proportions may exist as secondary traits but cannot be the sole biological explanation.

﻿CANON UPDATE — 2026-09-06
Species 002 — SOLAVYR
Adult male visual canon corrected and locked. Male capitulum is forward-facing in fixed 3D orientation: front = reproductive disk visible; side = disk points with the face; back = green receptacle/bracts visible. Canonical male reference Gen ID c3ba80c1-ac29-4e2b-b3d0-875e8925c4ed. This supersedes the prior male plate with the side-view orientation error.
Adult female Anatomical Reference 001 remains locked, Gen ID 3ed72808-a295-4714-96aa-9c81342a2ed9, with backward-facing capitulum and established female dimorphism.
Codex master advanced to v1.4 with corrected species ordering and visual plate.


SEEDWOKEN / PHYVERAN — GAME DESIGN MASTER


Purpose
Current-source design reference for the garden-growth game project. Keep the strongest current mechanics, visual direction, lore decisions, and technical priorities; superseded experiments should not remain authoritative.


Core Concept
A lightweight top-down garden-growth world with no human characters. The player interacts with living plant-linked creatures, weather, water, environmental signals, and an original ecological/fantasy setting.


Naming
Seedwoken is the accessible/mainstream project name currently in use. Phyveran is the more professional or evolved naming direction reserved for future refinement.


Player Role
The controllable character is the Wellkeeper. Movement should feel smooth, readable, and intentional on both touch and desktop. Preferred interaction direction includes joystick and click-to-move rather than dependence on WASD.


Opening Loop
The player begins by choosing among three species/signals. The choice leads into an egg/seed-linked creature system. Creatures should hatch visibly, appear reliably in-world, and follow the player correctly.


Creature System
Creatures are plant-linked beings with staged development. Their stages should be biologically inspired and visually coherent rather than framed as generic monster evolutions. Cards and eggs should communicate lineage, stage, and identity clearly.


World & Lore
Earth-like environmental zones and weather systems, including Pacific Northwest influence, are part of the identity. The setting contains no humans and should build its own internal history and ecological logic.


Visual Direction
Readable, polished 2D presentation with strong cards, distinctive Wellkeeper lineages/color schemes, ancient well imagery, cleaner terrain, and reduced grain. Character art must be complete at selection screens and in-game; broken placeholders are unacceptable.


Movement & Camera Standard
Fix facing direction, follow behavior, camera direction, and joystick scale before adding unnecessary new features. The game should feel responsive rather than choppy.


Known Priority Issues
Wellkeeper selection artwork quality and completeness; creature appearance after hatching; creature follow behavior; lateral facing; camera behavior; card clipping; accidental UI interactions; egg/card visual artifacts; consistent animation logic.


Technical Direction
Keep systems structured so assets, logic, and design decisions can eventually transfer into a more advanced engine such as Unreal without requiring a conceptual rebuild.


Design Rule
Core playability and visual clarity take priority over feature expansion. New additions should not be layered on top of unresolved movement, selection, or creature-spawn problems.


Expanded Historical Specifications


World Structure
The early prototype is a 2D top-down garden-growth game intended to stay lightweight while proving the core systems. The world should feel Earth-adjacent rather than abstract: recognizable seasons, weather, terrain zones, plant relationships, and Pacific Northwest species can coexist with original fantasy ecology.
The game should not introduce human NPCs simply to explain systems. Lore, signs, environmental behavior, the well, cards, creatures, and discoveries should teach the world organically.


Wellkeeper
The Wellkeeper is the player's visible unit rather than a generic cursor/avatar. Four visual lineage/color schemes were explored; each needs fully finished artwork rather than palette-swapped unfinished boxes.
Movement requirements:
• touchscreen joystick support;
• click/tap-to-move support;
• no dependency on WASD as the primary design;
• correct left/right facing when moving laterally;
• camera follows in the same intuitive direction as movement;
• joystick should not dominate the playfield;
• acceleration/follow behavior should feel smooth rather than snapping/chopping.


Three-Signal Opening
The opening uses three discoverable signals/species choices. Each signal should communicate that an interaction is available and what the player is offering/doing; the earlier 'offer water drop' interaction was not self-explanatory enough and needs an explicit prompt/feedback state.
Selecting a signal should present a polished species card and lead into the egg/hatching sequence. The other species remain discoverable/acquirable later rather than permanently locking the player out.


Eggs, Hatching & Stages
Each creature lineage uses an egg/seed-linked origin and three developmental stages. Use 'stages' rather than generic 'evolutions.'
The hatch sequence should be visually legible and deterministic enough that the creature actually exists in the world afterward.
Required post-hatch behavior:
1. spawn the correct creature instance;
2. attach the correct lineage/stage data;
3. make it visibly appear at a safe valid location;
4. begin follow behavior;
5. preserve it across the relevant game state instead of visually disappearing.
Creature art should be produced as clean isolated assets with useful angles/poses so future animation or 3D translation is possible.


Cards & UI
Species/signal cards are part of the identity, not disposable UI. Card artwork should have complete top and bottom bounds, readable hierarchy, clean framing, and no clipped artwork.
Known prior UI defects to prevent:
• top of visual cards being cut off;
• top-right seed text accidentally opening an unrelated dictionary interaction;
• line/artifact through the sunflower egg asset;
• unfinished Wellkeeper/Gatekeeper artwork blocking selection;
• unclear interaction prompts;
• oversized joystick;
• selection art differing from the actual in-game character.


Well / Environment
The well should read as ancient, important, and physically embedded in the world rather than a small decorative circle. Earlier visual direction called for a larger, more monumental well and a cleaner surrounding play area.
Map direction included expanding usable space toward the right while reducing excessive grain and over-vibrance. Terrain should support readability of characters, signals, eggs, and cards instead of visually competing with them.


Growth Mechanic
Water/cooling interactions are central to growth. Growth should feel causal: player action → environmental/creature response → visible development. Avoid adding systems that obscure this primary loop before it is satisfying.


Art & Animation Standard
Characters need more than a glow or recolor to communicate lineage. Silhouette, markings, material/plant traits, accessories, and animation language should contribute.
Animation should preserve character identity across directional movement. If sprites are generated or redrawn, directional frames must be checked against one another rather than assumed consistent.
Cards, eggs, creatures, and menu portraits should look like one product family.


Current Development Priority Order
1. Make Wellkeeper selection reliably usable with finished art.
2. Fix core movement, lateral facing, camera follow, and joystick behavior.
3. Make hatch → spawn → follow work every time.
4. Repair card clipping, accidental UI taps, and visual artifacts.
5. Bring cards/creatures/Wellkeeper/environment to a coherent visual standard.
6. Only then expand map, systems, lore events, and additional species.


Future Portability
Keep data for species, stages, cards, movement parameters, world objects, and interactions separate from rendering wherever possible. This makes a future Unreal or more advanced-engine migration feasible without rewriting the game concept from scratch.

VISUAL ASSET INDEX — CRIXYNCO


Purpose
This index governs the curated visual archive. It records which visual families belong in the master library and how to decide which version is authoritative.


Core Selection Rule
Keep the strongest current or final approved version of a visual concept. If later edits were made because an earlier version was disliked, inaccurate, unfinished, overly grainy, poorly composed, visually broken, or otherwise superseded, the later successful correction should replace the earlier version in the curated archive.


When Multiple Versions Are Allowed
Keep more than one image only when the versions serve genuinely different purposes: separate panels in a series, distinct stages in an instructional progression, alternate aspect ratios needed for publishing, intentionally different compositions, or client-requested variants that remain useful.


Categories
01 — Art & Illustration
Traditional-art studies, finished illustration, botanical/fantasy artwork, drawing tutorial visuals, and standalone artistic compositions.


02 — Branding & Logos
CrixynCo marks, emblems, logo families, brand banners, identity explorations that remain current, and finalized icon systems.


03 — Gardening & Plants
Plant photography, seed/garden visuals, crop studies, garden education, container-growing references, and other horticultural assets.


04 — Game & App Design
Seedwoken/Phyveran assets, Rooted Northwest interface/graphics, sprites, cards, icons, app concepts, UI references, and product-design visuals.


05 — Nature, Wildlife & Science
Wildlife, geology, natural history, ocean/deep-sea subjects, scientific infographics, landscape-history work, and educational nature visuals.


06 — Social & Marketing
Promotional graphics, story/reel assets, QR/link promotions, campaign graphics, banners, and other platform-facing marketing material.


07 — Client & Professional
Client deliverables, professional visual aids, resume previews, workplace support graphics, website/deployment screenshots worth retaining, and business-process references.


08 — Review Before Keep
Temporary holding area for visuals whose final status is unclear. Nothing here should be treated as authoritative until reviewed.


Current Known Keeper Families
CrixynCo crescent-moon/leaf identity — retain only the strongest current identity direction rather than all logo experiments.
Rooted Northwest — favor the most evolved current logo/icon family and current app-graphics direction.
Colored-pencil learning — favor corrected/refined studies when an earlier instructional graphic was replaced.
The Land Remembers / Missoula Floods — preserve the intended series panels and strongest supporting factual visuals; reject weaker redundant attempts.
Deep-sea / wildlife work — retain distinct finished compositions and useful infographics rather than near-identical experiments.
Garden and plant work — retain useful final educational or publishing assets; reject redundant generated variations.
Client work — preserve final deliverables and only those process screenshots that document a still-relevant workflow.


Naming Standard
Where practical, use descriptive filenames that identify the subject and purpose. Generic camera names or generation timestamps should be renamed only when the visual has been positively identified.


Archive Standard
The curated library is a working master asset collection, not a complete history. The original source Library can preserve historical iterations separately. Do not clutter the curated Drive library with rejected drafts simply because they exist.

Yes. I confirmed that **PHYVERA is registered as an existing Site under your ChatGPT account**, not merely as a link or temporary file. Another ChatGPT Work chat can retrieve and continue developing it through the Sites connection.

Send this directive to the lead chat:

> PHYVERA already exists as a private ChatGPT Site at [https://phyvera.crixyn.chatgpt.site](https://phyvera.crixyn.chatgpt.site). Use the Sites tools to locate the existing Site named “PHYVERA.” Do not create a replacement Site. Retrieve its current source/version and continue development on that same Site while preserving its private owner-only access, persistent database, existing architecture, and established Seedwoken canon boundaries.

Important distinction:

-  Chats inside the same ChatGPT Project share the Project’s uploaded files, instructions, and connected sources. [Official OpenAI documentation](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/projects?utm_source=chatgpt.com) 
-  The **PHYVERA Site itself is accessed through Sites**, so the lead chat must be in **Work mode with Sites available**. 
-  It does not need the original temporary development folder. 
-  It should locate PHYVERA by name and continue the existing Site instead of rebuilding it. 
-  An ordinary Chat response may understand the URL and conversation history, but it needs Work/Sites access to inspect and modify the application. 

So the correct setup is: keep both chats inside the same Project for shared Seedwoken knowledge, and tell the lead development chat to retrieve the existing PHYVERA Site through Sites.

The functional Milestone 1 build is now the baseline for PHYVERA.

Do not create another Site, fork PHYVERA, or rebuild the application.

Preserve the current working version before beginning the next milestone so we have a rollback point.

The next milestone will be:

PHYVERA VISUAL & INTERACTION SYSTEM v1

Before modifying anything, inspect the complete existing PHYVERA Site and its current implementation.

I have a Crixyn animated logo/video asset that will become part of the PHYVERA home-screen visual identity. The visual patch will also introduce a much more sophisticated Seedwoken-specific interaction system, including desktop mouse responses, mobile touch responses, animated controls, biological interface effects, transitions, and premium button behavior.

Do NOT design or implement those effects yet.

First audit the existing Site specifically for the upcoming visual patch.

Determine:

- which existing components and layouts should be preserved
- which visual components need replacement or refinement
- current responsive/mobile behavior
- current navigation behavior
- current animation/transition architecture
- how a video banner can be incorporated efficiently
- where pointer/mouse interactions can safely be introduced
- equivalent touch behavior for mobile/tablet
- how button animations can be implemented without harming usability
- how reduced-motion accessibility should work
- which portions of the interface need to remain visually quiet for reading biological information
- whether any existing implementation would make future interactive 3D specimen viewing difficult

Also preserve all existing biological data, species records, Veyra information, lifecycle information, glossary information, Canon Sync information, persistence, and working functionality.

Do not deploy the visual patch yet.

Return the audit to me and wait for the PHYVERA Visual & Interaction System v1 specification.

Audit complete. No code, data, or deployment was changed.

The currently deployed **PHYVERA Version 1** remains the preserved rollback point. I also verified the live database still contains the existing Rosavyn, Tomavyn, biology, lifecycle, Roseblush Veyra, glossary, visual-reference, and Canon Sync tables.

## Preserve

These parts form a strong foundation for the visual patch:

-  Fixed desktop sidebar and compact top context bar 
-  Current navigation categories and information architecture 
-  Home → Library → Species Workspace flow 
-  Species-level Biology, Lifecycle, Veyra, and Visual Reference tabs 
-  Plain-language / biological-detail toggle 
-  Canon, Proposal, and Unknown status system 
-  Dark botanical color direction 
-  Georgia-style biological/editorial headings 
-  Persistent D1 database and API layer 
-  Responsive card and reading layouts 
-  Existing dialog-based creation workflows 
-  Human-controlled Canon Sync principle 

The upcoming patch should treat these as existing product behavior—not redesign the application around a different structure.

## Refine or replace visually

The weakest visual areas are:

-  The generic leaf emblem and CSS-generated species glyphs 
-  The home-screen orbital specimen graphic 
-  Flat cards with limited visual hierarchy 
-  Basic bright-green rectangular primary buttons 
-  Inconsistent secondary/text-button affordances 
-  Simple modal presentation 
-  Status pills that are functional but visually generic 
-  Quiet but somewhat unfinished top header 
-  Repetitive surface styling across biologically different sections 
-  Lack of loading transitions and meaningful change feedback 

The home-screen specimen graphic is the clearest replacement point for the Crixyn animated logo/video. The existing hero text and Create Phyvera action should remain.

## Current responsive behavior

Desktop:

-  Sidebar remains fixed at 260 pixels. 
-  Main content stays separate and scrollable. 
-  Biology uses a sticky specimen panel beside the biological records. 
-  Lifecycle shows all seven stages horizontally in a grid. 
-  Primary navigation buttons have good desktop-sized hit areas. 

Mobile under 760 pixels:

-  Sidebar becomes an off-canvas drawer. 
-  A hamburger button opens navigation. 
-  Cards, forms, references, and Biology stack vertically. 
-  Lifecycle becomes a horizontally swipeable row. 
-  Species tabs remain horizontally scrollable. 
-  The home specimen graphic disappears completely. 
-  Page actions move beneath headings. 
-  The biological-detail toggle expands across the available width. 

The mobile structure is workable, but several icon-only and text controls are approximately 24 pixels tall—smaller than desirable touch targets. These should gain larger invisible/visible hit areas during the interaction patch.

## Navigation behavior

PHYVERA is currently a single-page React application using internal state rather than separate URLs.

Advantages:

-  Navigation feels immediate. 
-  Species selection persists while moving between biological sections. 
-  Visual transitions can be coordinated centrally. 
-  No route-loading flashes currently occur. 

Limitations:

-  Refreshing always returns to Home. 
-  Browser Back does not move through PHYVERA sections. 
-  Individual species or biological sections cannot be bookmarked. 
-  All interface logic currently lives in one large page component. 

Visual v1 does not require converting everything into routes, but the page should be separated into reusable shell, navigation, species workspace, modal, button, and motion components before sophisticated interaction logic accumulates.

## Current animation architecture

There is almost no animation system yet:

-  Mobile sidebar uses one short transform transition. 
-  Species cards move upward on hover, but without a coordinated transition. 
-  No page transitions 
-  No loading-state choreography 
-  No button press animation 
-  No pointer tracking 
-  No touch-response layer 
-  No reduced-motion rules 
-  No centralized motion durations or easing values 

This means the next milestone has a clean starting point, but motion should be introduced through shared design tokens and reusable interaction components—not scattered CSS rules.

## Video-banner integration

The existing Home hero is already the right structural container.

Recommended approach for the specification:

-  Incorporate the video within the hero instead of adding another large section. 
-  Use it as the right-side identity surface on desktop. 
-  Adapt it into a shallow cinematic banner or cropped identity panel on mobile. 
-  Use `muted`, `playsInline`, and controlled looping where appropriate. 
-  Provide a still poster frame before playback. 
-  Avoid loading the full video before the interface becomes usable. 
-  Pause playback when offscreen or when the page is backgrounded. 
-  Show the poster instead of autoplaying when reduced motion is enabled. 
-  Keep text contrast independent from the changing video frames. 

PHYVERA currently has no media-storage binding. The final asset size and format will determine whether it belongs directly in the Site package or in proper object storage.

## Safe pointer-interaction zones

Pointer-responsive effects can safely appear on:

-  Home video/specimen identity area 
-  Navigation indicators 
-  Species cards 
-  Creation-mode cards 
-  Primary and secondary buttons 
-  Lifecycle-stage cards 
-  Veyra pigment previews 
-  Visual-reference thumbnails 
-  Tabs and toggles 

Pointer tracking should not disturb:

-  Biology record text 
-  Glossary definitions 
-  Canon statements 
-  Form fields 
-  Approval/rejection controls 
-  Long reading surfaces 

Those areas should remain steady, high-contrast, and visually quiet.

## Mobile and tablet equivalents

No essential behavior should depend on hovering.

Desktop responses should translate into:

-  Press compression rather than hover lift 
-  Short biological pulses from the touch point 
-  Persistent selected states 
-  Swipeable lifecycle/reference areas 
-  Clear tap confirmation 
-  Larger touch targets 
-  No cursor-following effect on touch devices 
-  No delayed actions that make taps feel sluggish 

Pointer capabilities should be detected through input features such as hover and fine-pointer support, not screen width alone.

## Premium button behavior

The current buttons can support a shared premium button system without changing their underlying actions.

The safe sequence is:

1.  Immediate press compression 
2.  Very short internal biological light/pigment response 
3.  Action execution 
4.  Loading or success state where saving occurs 
5.  Return to rest without layout movement 

Effects should never obscure labels, move the click target, delay destructive choices, or make Canon approval feel playful or ambiguous. Canon decisions should receive restrained, deliberate motion.

## Reduced-motion requirements

The current implementation has no reduced-motion support. Visual v1 should add a global reduced-motion mode that:

-  Replaces video autoplay with its poster frame 
-  Disables cursor-following and parallax 
-  Removes large scaling and traveling effects 
-  Replaces page movement with brief fades or immediate changes 
-  Stops decorative looping animations 
-  Preserves essential loading and success feedback 
-  Maintains visible selected, pressed, and focus states 

## Quiet reading areas

The following should remain low-motion:

-  Biology system rows 
-  Technical explanations 
-  Glossary entries 
-  Canon Update Queue statements 
-  Forms and field labels 
-  Biological-detail mode 
-  Unknown/proposed/canon labels 

Motion should frame the information—not animate the information itself.

## Future 3D specimen compatibility

The current interface does not block future 3D viewing. The sticky specimen panel in Biology is an excellent eventual viewer location, and the Visual Lab provides a natural management surface.

However, two architectural limitations must be addressed before 3D work:

-  The present specimen graphic is a decorative CSS component rather than a replaceable viewer module. 
-  Species data does not yet include structured anatomical regions, parent/child relationships, selectable geometry identifiers, or 3D asset references. 

For Visual v1, the specimen surface should become a self-contained component with clean pointer-event boundaries. That will let a future 3D viewer replace its internal display without rebuilding the Biology workspace.

PHYVERA is ready for the visual milestone. I’ll wait for the **PHYVERA Visual & Interaction System v1 specification** before changing anything.

Apply this patch to the EXISTING PHYVERA Site you just audited.

- replace its database

==================================================
CORE VISUAL CONCEPT
==================================================

PHYVERA should feel like a sophisticated biological instrument created specifically for studying life on Vaelora.

Its visual identity belongs to the Crixyn ecosystem, but PHYVERA has its own specialized biological character.

The desired combination is:

CRIXYN
dark dimensional materials
obsidian/near-black space
metallic depth
cerulean electrical energy
turquoise/blue-green living energy
sharp restrained highlights

×

SEEDWOKEN
living botanical structures
vascular patterns
organic branching
pigmentation
growth
biological responses
naturalistic surfaces

×

PHYVERA
precision biological instrument
professional scientific information
specimen inspection
canon management
biological intelligence

The interface should NOT resemble:

- generic SaaS
- generic AI dashboard
- neon cyberpunk
- fantasy RPG UI
- green eco-app
- excessive glassmorphism
- mobile game
- holographic spaceship interface

The governing interaction principle is:

QUIET WHEN STUDIED.
ALIVE WHEN TOUCHED.

When the user is reading biology, PHYVERA should become calm, precise, dark, highly legible and professional.

When the user interacts with PHYVERA, the interface should briefly feel biologically alive.

==================================================
CRIXYN CINEMATIC BANNER
==================================================

A Crixyn animated logo/video asset has been supplied for PHYVERA.

Use this actual supplied asset rather than recreating the animation.

Integrate it into the existing Home hero.

DESKTOP:

The cinematic identity surface should occupy the visual/specimen side of the existing hero.

Do not simply place a rectangular video player on the page.

The video should feel integrated into PHYVERA's surface.

Use masking, controlled gradients, edge treatment, dark blending or similar techniques so the video emerges naturally from the hero.

Preserve the existing hero text and Create Phyvera action.

The animation may play when PHYVERA is opened and then resolve into a calmer identity state.

Avoid an endlessly distracting intro loop.

MOBILE:

Do NOT hide PHYVERA's identity entirely as the existing specimen graphic currently does.

Create a shallower cinematic treatment appropriate to portrait displays.

Crop/reframe rather than shrinking the desktop composition.

PERFORMANCE:

Use:
- muted
- playsInline
- poster frame
- lazy/controlled loading where appropriate

Reduced Motion:
show the poster/static resolved identity instead of autoplay.

MATERIAL SYSTEM

Replace the current repetitive flat-card appearance with a restrained material hierarchy.

Develop reusable surfaces such as:

INSTRUMENT SURFACE
Primary application panels.
Very dark charcoal/obsidian.
Subtle material depth.
Extremely restrained edge definition.

BIOLOGICAL SURFACE

May contain almost imperceptible vascular, cellular or botanical structure.

SPECIMEN SURFACE

Deeper visual space.
Designed explicitly so the internal renderer can later be replaced with a 3D viewer.

CANON SURFACE
Calm, authoritative, extremely legible.
Avoid excessive decorative motion.

Do not make every panel visually unique.
Create a coherent reusable design system.

COLOR
==================================================

Base:
near-black
obsidian
charcoal
dark metallic neutrals

Primary living interaction:
cerulean
blue-green
turquoise

Botanical greens should exist but should no longer dominate every primary action.

Use brighter color primarily to communicate:
interaction
biological activity
selection
generation
status
meaning

Do not flood entire surfaces with saturated colors.

==================================================
TYPOGRAPHY
==================================================

Create a clearer hierarchy between:

PHYVERA identity
species names
scientific/botanical information
section headings
plain-language explanations
technical biological detail
metadata
canon status

Scientific information should feel authoritative without becoming difficult to read.

==================================================
LIVING FIELD POINTER SYSTEM
==================================================

DESKTOP/FINE POINTER ONLY.

Do NOT create a gimmicky custom cursor or long glowing cursor trail.

Instead create a subtle environmental response around interactive surfaces.

When the pointer approaches certain interactive elements:

- extremely subtle edge illumination may respond to proximity
- faint biological/vascular details may respond
- surface highlights may shift slightly
- species cards may exhibit tiny dimensional response
- interactive specimen areas may indicate inspectability

The pointer itself should remain precise.

Effects must be localized.

Never apply pointer-reactive movement to:
- Biology reading rows
- Glossary definitions
- Canon statements
- long-form text
- form fields
- approval/rejection text

Use pointer capability detection:
hover + fine pointer
rather than screen width.

==================================================
BUTTON SYSTEM
==================================================

Replace generic bright-green rectangular buttons with a reusable PHYVERA control system.

Buttons should feel physical and responsive.

PRIMARY BUTTON REST:

dark dimensional body
precise outline/edge
restrained living-energy channel
excellent label contrast

HOVER:

do not simply change background color.

Allow a restrained cerulean/blue-green energy response to travel or emerge around the boundary.

PRESS:

1. immediate physical compression
2. energy contracts toward the interaction point
3. short internal biological pulse
4. action executes
5. confirmation/release
6. return to rest

Target interaction duration:
fast and responsive, generally around 200–350 ms for the complete tactile response.

Never delay the actual application action just to finish an animation.

Create variants for:

PRIMARY
SECONDARY
QUIET
DESTRUCTIVE
CANON
GENERATE

Each should belong to the same family.

==================================================
SEMANTIC MOTION LANGUAGE
==================================================

Do not randomly assign animations.

PHYVERA has a semantic motion vocabulary.

LIVING FIELD
Meaning:
available biological/interactable surface

Used for:
pointer proximity
species cards
specimen surfaces

BIOLOGICAL SCAN
Meaning:
inspect/analyze

Used for:
species inspection
future anatomical inspection
visual-reference examination

VASCULAR PULSE
Meaning:
successful information transfer/save

Used for:
saved biological information
successful update
completed non-canon action

CANON IMPRINT
Meaning:
information has formally entered established Seedwoken canon

Used ONLY for:
accepted Canon Sync changes
formal canon establishment

This animation should feel deliberate and significant, NOT celebratory or game-like.

GERMINATION / BRANCHING
Meaning:
new biological entity/variation created

Used for:
Create Phyvera
new Veyra
future genetic branches

ENERGY CONVERGENCE
Meaning:
generation/computation

Used for:
future AI generation
future Visual Lab image generation
biological analysis

WITHDRAWAL
Meaning:
rejected/removed/not accepted

Used for:
reject proposal
remove experimental reference

Avoid giant red flashes.
Allow illumination to retract/extinguish instead.

==================================================
CREATE PHYVERA
==================================================

This should become one of the signature interactions.

The Create Phyvera control should feel important without being enormous.

When activated:

brief biological energy/germination response
→ creation interface transition

Do not use a generic modal pop animation.

Refine the existing dialog presentation into something consistent with the biological instrument identity.

==================================================
SPECIES CARDS
==================================================

Replace CSS-generated species glyphs as the dominant identity.

Cards should be designed for real canonical imagery when available.

Support:

canonical visual
species name
botanical ancestry
canon state
essential biological metadata

Pointer movement may cause VERY subtle depth response on desktop.

Maximum tilt should remain restrained.

No dramatic 3D card flipping.

Touch:
short compression + biological pulse.

Cards must remain useful when no canonical image exists.

Create a sophisticated unknown/unresolved specimen treatment rather than a generic placeholder icon.

==================================================
BIOLOGY WORKSPACE
==================================================

This is one of the QUIET zones.

Prioritize:
readability
hierarchy
comparison
biological understanding

Do not animate biological paragraphs.

Do not move rows in response to pointer position.

Interaction effects may exist around controls and the specimen viewer but NOT underneath reading material.

Refactor the existing sticky specimen area into a dedicated:

SpecimenViewport

component or equivalent.

Its internals may currently display existing 2D/reference content.

Architect its boundary so a future interactive 3D renderer can replace its internal content without rebuilding Biology.

==================================================
LIFECYCLE
==================================================

Make the lifecycle feel like biological development rather than seven unrelated cards.

Preserve:
Seed
Seedling
Kindling
Seedform
Infant
Mid Stage
Adult

Create a restrained developmental connection/progression between stages.

Selecting a stage may propagate a short living signal along the developmental path toward that stage.

Do not constantly animate the lifecycle.

Mobile remains horizontally swipeable.

Make selected stage extremely clear.

==================================================
VEYRA
==================================================

Veyra should visually communicate variation within ONE species.

Do not make Veyra look like separate species.

Pigmentation previews should become richer.

Creating a Veyra may use the Germination/Branching motion vocabulary.

Preserve the biological relationship:

PHYVERA = SPECIES
VEYRA = VISIBLE PIGMENTATION PHENOTYPE

==================================================
CANON SYSTEM
==================================================

Canon interactions deserve special restraint.

CANON
PROPOSAL
UNKNOWN
SUPERSEDED where applicable

should have a refined shared status language.

Do not simply use generic colored pills.

Canon acceptance:

User activates acceptance.
→ deliberate short Canon Imprint
→ state becomes canonical
→ interface settles

Reject:

use Withdrawal behavior.

Do not gamify canon decisions.

Do not make approval ambiguous.

==================================================
VISUAL LAB
==================================================

Refine Visual Lab into a serious specimen/reference workspace.

Clearly distinguish:

CANONICAL
EXPERIMENTAL
REJECTED
PROPOSED

Prepare its visual architecture for future OpenAI image generation.

Do NOT fake image generation.

Any unavailable generation capability remains visibly unavailable/future rather than pretending to operate.

==================================================
PAGE TRANSITIONS
==================================================

Introduce a shared transition system.

Navigation should feel continuous, not like unrelated pages appearing.

Transitions should generally be subtle:
short fade
small depth change
localized biological response

Avoid:
large slides
long fades
dramatic zooms
constant animation

The user should never wait for a transition.

==================================================
MOBILE / TOUCH
==================================================

The mobile experience is NOT a reduced desktop experience.

Translate interaction language appropriately.

No hover-dependent functionality.

Use:
press compression
touch-origin pulse
persistent selected states
swipe where appropriate
clear confirmation

Increase undersized controls to approximately 44×44 touch targets where possible.

Preserve mobile off-canvas navigation.

Do not create cursor effects on touch devices.

==================================================
ACCESSIBILITY
==================================================

Implement global prefers-reduced-motion behavior.

Reduced motion should:

- disable autoplaying decorative video
- use banner poster
- disable cursor tracking
- disable parallax
- disable decorative looping
- eliminate large movement/scaling
- retain immediate pressed states
- retain selection
- retain loading feedback
- retain success/failure feedback
- preserve focus indication

Maintain keyboard navigation.

Maintain high text contrast.

Do not sacrifice usability for visual spectacle.

==================================================
ARCHITECTURAL REFACTOR
==================================================

Your audit identified that too much interface logic currently lives in one large page component.

Before layering sophisticated motion everywhere, perform the MINIMUM safe refactor needed to establish reusable components.

Prefer reusable systems such as:

AppShell
Navigation
HomeHero
SpeciesCard
SpecimenViewport
PhyveraButton
StatusIndicator
Modal/Dialog
LifecycleStage
Motion primitives/tokens

Names may differ according to the existing architecture.

Create centralized design tokens for:

motion durations
easing
surface materials
borders
interaction intensity
focus
colors
spacing where appropriate

Do NOT perform a broad application rewrite.

==================================================
PERFORMANCE
==================================================

PHYVERA must remain responsive on:

Windows desktop
Android phone
Android tablet

Effects should primarily use performant CSS properties where possible.

Avoid large numbers of continuously animated elements.

Avoid expensive pointer calculations across the whole page.

Pointer effects should be local and throttled/requestAnimationFrame controlled where appropriate.

The application should feel faster after the patch, not slower.

==================================================
QUALITY STANDARD
==================================================

This is not a superficial color reskin.

The objective is to create a recognizable PHYVERA interaction language.

However:

SPECTACLE MUST COME FROM RESPONSE TO USER ACTION.

Not from constant motion.

At rest:
dark
calm
biological
professional
precise

During interaction:
responsive
living
dimensional
distinctive
Seedwoken

==================================================
IMPLEMENTATION
==================================================

Proceed autonomously.

Use the existing Site and database.

Apply the patch systematically.

Do not stop for routine aesthetic decisions.

Do not invent Seedwoken canon.

Do not implement future 3D or AI generation during this patch.

After implementation, test:

desktop layout
mobile layout
tablet/responsive behavior
navigation
every primary button
dialogs
species cards
Biology
Lifecycle
Veyra
Visual Lab
Glossary
Canon Sync
pointer behavior
touch equivalents
keyboard interaction
reduced-motion behavior
video/banner fallback
persistence
existing biological data
existing canon state

Verify no working Milestone 1 functionality was lost.

Then deploy/update the EXISTING private PHYVERA Site.

Return:

1. concise description of what changed
2. any implementation compromises
3. any remaining placeholders
4. performance/accessibility findings
5. confirmation that existing data/canon survived
6. confirmation that the existing PHYVERA Site—not a replacement—was updated
